subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a55e9ef82096ceb3647d47756dcdacd90a546343d6c607c9ad8e9a096fa8e2f.png]
solution:
The logic here is:

**Logic: 2ⁿd number x (3rd number div 2) = 1st number**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ad18e21a7711b951c786d45a428ad8584500336539df5e4e43d6391f03d41d.png] 

= 8 times ((9)/(2)) = 8 times (4.5) = 36 

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45c39750c87dd11ee5cf6c376f5b41d9f39575cf3e2545970e5e31a13882406b.png] 

= 7 times ((6)/(2)) = 7 times (3) = 21

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07c15b625a2f5bd0f637c2ee16d3c7b87ba1549be0c9ab8d3b3318077f7346cd.png] 

= 5 times ((4)/(2)) = 5 times (2) = 10

Thus, the missing number is '**10**'.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
